gloss: to be crushed; to collapse; to go bankrupt

definitions.gloss: to be crushed; to be squashed
definitions.explanation: For something to be flattened or deformed by pressure.
For a business, plan, or organization to fail or go bankrupt.

definitions.gloss: to be wasted; to be ruined
definitions.explanation: For time, a day, or opportunity to be lost or wasted.

examples.japanese: {空|あ}き{缶|かん}が{潰|つぶ}れた。
あの{店|みせ}は{去年|きょねん}{潰|つぶ}れた。
examples.english: That store went out of business last year.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}で{休日|きゅうじつ}が{潰|つぶ}れてしまった。
examples.english: The rain ruined my day off.

notes:
{潰|つぶ}れる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to be crushed or to fail.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: {潰|つぶ}す (to crush, to destroy)
- {潰|つぶ}れる: The can gets crushed.
- {潰|つぶ}す: I crush the can.

ASPECT (ている):
{潰|つぶ}れている indicates something has been crushed/has failed and remains so.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]が{潰|つぶ}れる — [thing] gets crushed/fails
- [business]が{潰|つぶ}れる — [business] goes bankrupt

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {会社|かいしゃ}が{潰|つぶ}れる (company goes bankrupt)
- {予定|よてい}が{潰|つぶ}れる (plans fall through)
- {声|こえ}が{潰|つぶ}れる (voice becomes hoarse)
- お{酒|さけ}で{潰|つぶ}れる (to pass out drunk)

COLLOQUIAL USE:
{潰|つぶ}れる is commonly used for businesses closing, but also casually for getting too drunk (お{酒|さけ}で{潰|つぶ}れる).
